stays.name: Cozy Tapovan
stays.summary: A warm, plant-filled flat in Tapovan with a curtained living nook, a reading corner and a lit-up balcony.
stays.description: Cozy Tapovan is set up for slow mornings: soft light, plenty of plants, a kitchen you can actually cook in and a living room made for doing nothing. There's a canopy reading nook, a bedroom with full-length windows and a balcony strung with fairy lights for the evenings. Tapovan's cafés and yoga schools are close by.

stays.description: Your family will be close to everything when you stay at this centrally located place. Welcome to Tapovan Tranquil by Nestique, a cozy and serene hideaway in the hills of Tapovan, near Deecon Valley Society. stays.name: The Prakashdeep Villa
stays.tagline: Breakfast included, valley views and a fire pit
stays.summary: A peaceful villa in the Pauri Garhwal hills, with breakfast included and room for the whole family.
stays.description: Relax with the whole family at this peaceful place to stay in the Garhwal hills, close to the villages of Santudhar, Satpuli, Kirkhu and Patisain. Evenings are for the fire pit and the outdoor dining area, and breakfast is included, with a kitchen for your own meals too.

Breakfast included, plus a kitchen

stays.name: The Amelie Villa
stays.tagline: A farm stay in a peaceful Himalayan village
stays.summary: A 3BHK farm stay in Isoti village, with a huge terrace, a garden porch and mountain air.
stays.description: Bring the whole family to The Amelie Villa, a cozy 3BHK homestay in the peaceful Isoti village of Pauri Garhwal. Surrounded by lush mountains and fresh air, the villa offers spacious rooms with attached bathrooms, a huge terrace and a beautiful garden with a porch to relax and enjoy nature. It's an off-beat getaway for travellers looking for silence, scenic views and a true Himalayan village experience, with lots of room for fun.
